source.label: Tilt Forums Transporter LX-4.1 competition-ROM changelog

supportingSources.label: Kineticist Transporter record and stock L-3 file

strategy.summary: Build Transport Value, light its X-target collect, start three-ball Multiball, collect multiplied Transport Value, then complete R-E-S-C-U-E for Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: R-E-S-C-U-E locks
quickInfo.summary: Complete the left R-E-S bank and center C-U-E bank, then shoot the left U.N. Orion ramp for each of two locks.

quickInfo.name: Three-Ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: With two balls locked, shoot the lower-right Transporter scoop to release all three balls.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot sequence
quickInfo.summary: During Multiball, hit R, E, S, C, U, and E in order before one ball remains.

quickInfo.name: Transport Value
quickInfo.summary: Left-ramp shots and Transporter-cup spins raise the backglass value; the lit red X target collects it.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: During multiball, hit R-E-S-C-U-E in order for the progressive award, which playfield multipliers do not change.

quickInfo.name: Playfield X
quickInfo.summary: LX-4.1 gives 3x with three balls and 2x with two balls for all scoring except Jackpot.

steps.text: Plunge softly enough that the ball first enters the spinner path below U.N. Orion.
modeNotes: Skill shot: The first award is 50,000. Each later successful plunge adds 50,000.
A short plunge returns for another attempt. The skill shot is not available after a locked-ball replacement plunge.

steps.text: Cradle the first controlled return. Test the left ramp, Transporter scoop feed, and upper-right flipper strength.
Before two balls are locked, shoot the lower-right Transporter scoop and hold the upper-right flipper.
modeNotes: Transporter scoop: It feeds the upper-right flipper. With fewer than two locked balls, the scoop does not start multiball.

steps.text: From the upper-right flipper, shoot across the clear Transporter bridge into the Transporter cup.
Use cup spins and left-ramp shots to build Transport Value toward 1,000,000.
modeNotes: Transport Value: The backglass shows fifteen steps from 10,000 through 1,000,000.
Each ten or fifteen seconds without a collect can lower the value by one step. The timer is operator-set.

steps.text: Shoot the left ramp while its lock is not lit to light the red X target for Transport Value.
Complete the left R-E-S three-drop bank and the center C-U-E three-drop bank.
modeNotes: R-E-S-C-U-E: A full completion lights one lock and relights the left kickback.
Default easy locks can spot R, E, and S from return lanes. RESCUE memory and Easy Lock are operator settings.

steps.text: Shoot the lit left U.N. Orion ramp to lock ball 1. Repeat R-E-S-C-U-E and the ramp for ball 2.
Before the second lock, keep Transport Value high and confirm that the red X target is lit.
With two balls locked, shoot the Transporter scoop to start Three-Ball Multiball.
modeNotes: Three-Ball Multiball: The game feeds all three balls to the upper-right flipper. Multiball ends when one ball remains.

steps.text: While three balls remain, hit the red X target to collect Transport Value at 3x.
modeNotes: Playfield X: LX-4.1 multiplies Transport Value and other scoring by the active 3x or 2x value. Jackpot is excluded.
The same target also collects any lit Xcelerator Value.

steps.text: Hit R, E, S, C, U, and E in the indicated order for Jackpot.
modeNotes: Jackpot: The competition reset is 3,000,000 or 4,000,000. The playfield multiplier does not change this award.
Complete the sequence before multiball reaches one ball.

steps.text: If controlled, shoot the left ramp once during multiball to light alternating outlane Specials.

fallback.title: Single-ball Transport Value
fallback.when: Use this when R-E-S-C-U-E rebounds or lock-ramp returns make multiball unsafe.

steps.text: Shoot the Transporter scoop before two balls are locked.
Hold the upper-right flipper as the ball arrives.
Shoot the clear Transporter bridge into the cup for Transport Value advances.
Shoot the left ramp to add more advances and light the red X target.
Repeat the scoop, bridge, cup, and ramp while the return remains controlled.
At 1,000,000, shoot the red X target before the value decreases.
After the collect, one left-ramp shot relights the target and starts another build.

alternatives.title: Direct multiball and Jackpot
alternatives.when: Use this when the drop targets and lock ramp are safer than the upper bridge.

steps.text: Hit all six R-E-S-C-U-E targets to light the left-ramp lock.
Shoot the lit left ramp to lock ball 1.
Repeat the six targets and left ramp to lock ball 2.
Shoot the Transporter scoop to start Three-Ball Multiball.
Ignore the upper bridge if it is not controlled.
Hit R-E-S-C-U-E in order before one ball remains.
Collect the 3,000,000 or 4,000,000 Jackpot.

alternatives.title: Xcelerator and spinner
alternatives.when: Use this when the lane feeds and spinner are safer than either ramp.

steps.text: Use slingshot hits to move the lit lower inlane.
Roll through the lit inlane to raise Xcelerator Value and briefly light the spinner.
modeNotes: Xcelerator Value: The first lit inlane sets 50,000. Later lit inlanes add 50,000 through 250,000.

steps.text: Transfer control to the left flipper only when the center-post feed is predictable.
Shoot the spinner during its short lit window.
modeNotes: LX-4.1 spinner: An unlit spin scores 3,000. A lit spin scores the Adjustment 31 value from 3,000 through 9,000.

steps.text: Hit the red X target to collect Xcelerator Value.
If Transport Value is also lit, the same hit collects both awards.

alternatives.title: S-O-S and end-of-ball bonus
alternatives.when: Use this when top-lane feeds are controlled and the major shots reject.

steps.text: Use lane change when enabled to complete the three S-O-S top lanes.
Each completion raises Bonus X by one through 5x.
After 5x, later completions can light the fixed center lane for Extra Ball.
Return up top through the spinner lane or a lower-right shot into the bumpers.
Preserve the ball because base bonus and Bonus X reset after the ball.
Set Transport Value near 1,000,000 and light the red X target.
Lock two balls through R-E-S-C-U-E and the left ramp.
Start Three-Ball Multiball at the Transporter scoop.
Collect Transport Value while 3x remains for up to 3,000,000.
Complete R-E-S-C-U-E in order for the 4,000,000 competition Jackpot.
At one ball, rebuild the locks and Transport Value.

techniques.name: Repeatable skill plunge
techniques.instruction: Plunge softly into the spinner path below U.N. Orion, and retry when a short plunge returns to the shooter lane.

techniques.name: Upper-flipper trap
techniques.instruction: Hold the upper-right flipper as the Transporter scoop feeds it, then aim the bridge after the ball settles.

techniques.name: Live catch
techniques.instruction: Live catch the Transporter-scoop return on the left flipper before repeating the shot.

techniques.name: Post pass
techniques.instruction: Post pass a fast inlane return to the opposite flipper when the center-post rebound is controlled.

cautions.issue: An enabled incandescent bridge flasher can overheat and damage the clear ramp.
cautions.response: Set Adjustment 51 to No when the machine uses an incandescent flasher or needs location protection.

cautions.issue: Repeated Transporter shots can return without control and create a center drain.
cautions.response: Catch the return on the left flipper before another scoop attempt.

cautions.issue: The center-post transfer is not reliable and can send the ball between the flippers.
cautions.response: Test it once on a fast inlane feed, then stop if the transfer misses the opposite flipper.

checkBeforePlay: Test the upper-flipper trap, Transporter cup, scoop, and red X target.
strategy.simpleOverview: Transporter the Rescue uses the six R-E-S-C-U-E targets to light two left-ramp locks, then the Transporter scoop starts three-ball Multiball. Complete both target banks, take each lock at the left ramp, start at the scoop, then hit R-E-S-C-U-E in order for Jackpot.
strategy.overview: Transporter the Rescue uses the six R-E-S-C-U-E targets to light two left-ramp locks, then the Transporter scoop starts three-ball Multiball. Build and light the red-X collect before the second lock, start three-ball Multiball at the Transporter scoop, collect Transport Value while more balls remain, then complete R-E-S-C-U-E in order for Jackpot.
machineSetup: Test the upper-flipper trap, Transporter cup, scoop, and red X target.

changes: After 1,000,000 points, drop targets fall from 20,000 to 10,000, and each ramp or Transporter-cup hit advances the value once instead of twice.
The 3x and 2x playfield multipliers expire on short timers instead of following the number of balls in play.
Spinner scoring falls after 1,000,000 points, while the Jackpot uses the installed backglass and operator setting.

strategy.summary: Build Transport Value before 1,000,000 points, lock two balls through R-E-S-C-U-E, then start Three-Ball Multiball and collect the red X and ordered Jackpot before the short multiplier timer ends.

quickInfo.name: Score threshold
quickInfo.summary: After 1,000,000 points, drop, ramp, cup, and spinner values become less favorable. Build early.

quickInfo.name: Timed Playfield X
quickInfo.summary: Stock 3x and 2x scoring expire quickly. Prioritize the lit red X and the ordered R-E-S-C-U-E Jackpot sequence.

steps.text: Plunge softly into the spinner path. Retry when a short plunge returns to the shooter lane.
Cradle the first controlled return. Test the left ramp, Transporter scoop feed, and upper-right flipper strength.
Before reaching 1,000,000 points, use controlled cup spins and left-ramp shots to build Transport Value.
Shoot the left ramp while its lock is unlit to light the red X collect.
Complete R-E-S-C-U-E, then shoot the lit left ramp to lock ball 1.
Repeat R-E-S-C-U-E and the left ramp to lock ball 2.
Before starting multiball, keep Transport Value high and confirm that the red X target is lit.
Shoot the lower-right Transporter scoop to start Three-Ball Multiball.
Immediately collect the red X while stock 3x is active.
Hit R, E, S, C, U, and E in order for the stock Jackpot shown on the backglass.
Use any remaining 2x timer on the safest controlled repeat shot, then rebuild locks at one ball.

fallback.title: Stock single-ball Transport Value
fallback.when: Use this when drop-target rebounds or the lock ramp make multiball unsafe.

steps.text: Shoot the Transporter scoop before two balls are locked.
Hold the upper-right flipper as the ball arrives.
Shoot the bridge into the cup for Transport Value advances.
Shoot the left ramp to add more advances and light the red X target.
Collect the red X before the score threshold reduces stock scoring.
Relight it with another left-ramp shot and repeat while the feed stays controlled.

alternatives.title: Direct stock multiball
alternatives.when: Use this when the drop targets and left ramp are safer than the upper bridge.

steps.text: Complete R-E-S-C-U-E and lock ball 1.
Repeat the target bank and lock ball 2.
Shoot the Transporter scoop to start Three-Ball Multiball.
Use the brief playfield multiplier on the red X if it is ready.
Complete R-E-S-C-U-E in order for Jackpot.

alternatives.title: S-O-S and end-of-ball bonus

Collect the red X during the short 3x timer.
Complete ordered R-E-S-C-U-E for the stock Jackpot.

changes: Scoring no longer drops after the player reaches 1,000,000 points.
Playfield X remains at 3x with three balls and 2x with two balls instead of expiring on short stock timers.
Playfield X multiplies Transport Value but does not multiply the Jackpot.
Adjustments set the Jackpot to 3,000,000 or 4,000,000 and each cup hit to one, two, or three Transport Value advances.
